text:
marta: Heads-up — planning the next 2-sprint slice for Console observability. We need to decide pillar allocation across: dashboards (UX templates + cost views), tracing hooks (agent + sampling), cost breakdown (token-level attribution), error analytics (grouping + root-cause probes). Customers are pressing for cost visibility and trace hotspots. Thoughts?

devon: +1 on token-level cost breakdown, but heavy on infra work. We should scope to a coarse MVP: per-route + per-model cost first, not token-level for every org.

anya: Agreed. For rollout we can ship a sampled token breakdown for high-volume customers (top 10%) and aggregate for others. That reduces storage and query load. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

kevin: Tracing hooks — we can add a lightweight SDK hook to emit span-start/stop with request metadata. Sampling policy: 1% by default, configurable per-customer. Ops concern: if we ship full traces + token joins it will balloon, need retention plan.

marta: Good constraints. Proposal: sprint A focus = dashboards templates (cost + error) + tracing hook prototype with 1% sampling. sprint B = expand cost attribution (route/model) + error grouping UI and canary for traces. Launch criteria: "usable cost view for top 5 enterprise accounts" + "trace capture enabled without >10% increase in infra cost for our beta group".

samir: From Sales: FinFrame and Waypoint asked specifically for per-model cost per route. They prefer CSV export and an alert when cost increases >25% WoW. We should include export MVP.

anya: Export is fine as a first-class feature. For error analytics grouping, we should use a fingerprint heuristic: (error type + normalized stack snippet + model_id). That avoids user-facing noise.

kevin: Operational runbook ask: add a toggle per-tenant to disable tracing hooks immediately and a backfill job to recompute cost if we change attribution logic. Also we need an SLO for trace ingestion latency (<5s to show in console).

marta: Noted. Acceptance criteria draft: 1) Dashboard shows cost by route/model (last 7d), export to CSV. 2) Error analytics clusters with sample traces and first-seen timestamp. 3) Tracing hook SDK + sampling toggle; sampling config respected per-tenant. 4) No P0 infra regressions during beta.

devon: Estimate: dashboards templates + backend agg endpoints = 3 dev-weeks. Tracing hook prototype + ingestion pipeline = 4 dev-weeks. Error grouping + UI = 2 dev-weeks. QA + rollout + infra padding = 2 dev-weeks. Total across two sprints but need parallelization.

marta: We should surface tradeoffs to execs: faster shipping of templates vs. deeper token-level accuracy. I'll prepare a short page for the exec sync with opt-in beta list (FinFrame, Waypoint, and one internal).

observability-bot: Created ticket PROD-4981: "Console cost views + tracing hook prototype" — link: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-4981

samir: +1 on beta list. Also ask legal to confirm CSV export doesn't leak PII. I'll loop them in.

anya: Small technical note — for sampled token attribution we should attach a sparse KV of token counts per-model only for sampled requests, then extrapolate. That keeps storage bounded.

kevin: Also recommend a fallback policy: if ingestion queue lags > 30m, automatically drop trace payloads for non-beta customers and send alert to #eng-oncall.

marta: Good. Final ask: devon/anya/kevin — can you confirm feasibility by EOD Friday with rough implementation tasks? I'll collate and publish scope.

devon: Will do.

anya: I'll post a short doc with the proposed aggregation schema and sampling math.

kevin: I'll draft the runbook toggles + retention policy.

marta: Thanks team — will follow up with the exec brief and add acceptance criteria to PROD-4981. :thumbsup:
